name: Migration assistant
description: Assisted migration from other CRMs: recognized columns, conversion of their CSV exports and pre-filled imports

page.title: Migrate from another CRM
page.description: Bring organizations, people, deals (with their won or lost status), tasks and notes exported from another CRM. The assistant recognizes the export columns, converts dates, amounts and phone numbers and prepares the imports already mapped.
page.inferredHeaders: The recognized column names come from the public documentation of each tool and may vary with the account language and version. Columns that are not recognized can be mapped by hand when reviewing the import. So before importing, compare the numbers in the “Check against…” panel with what the source tool shows.

source.title: Which tool are you coming from?

steps.title: Import in this order from {{source}}
steps.description: Each step creates a draft import. Review the mapping and start it before moving to the next one, so links find the records already imported.

organizations.title: Companies
organizations.links: Companies come first so people and deals can be linked to them.

people.title: People
people.links: Each person is linked to the company by name; missing organizations are created.

deals.title: Deals
deals.links: Each deal is linked to the company and the person by name, and to the stages and workflow you choose below.

tasks.title: Activities
tasks.description: Upload the tasks or tasks CSV, usually {{file}}.
tasks.links: Import organizations, people and deals first: each activity is linked to the deal by title, to the person by e-mail or name and to the company by name. Types are matched by name and done tasks keep their date.

notes.title: Notes
notes.links: Each note is linked to the deal, person or company already imported; notes without a matching record are listed in the error report. Attachments are not part of CSV exports and are not migrated.

preview.summary: {{rows}} rows · {{recognized}} of {{total}} columns recognized · {{changed}} values converted
preview.unrecognizedHint: They stay in the file and can be linked to custom fields when reviewing the import.

maps.title: Matching for {{field}}
maps.keep: Keep the value of the file

hint.pipeline_id: Pick the Aphel pipeline for each pipeline of the source tool.
hint.stage_id: Pick the Aphel stage for each stage of the source tool. Stages without a match must exist in Aphel with the same name.
hint.owner_id: Owners are matched by the name or email of the members. Pick the member when the name differs; without a match the record has no owner.

import.missing: The import created in this step is no longer available.

check.ok: Checked: all {{rows}} rows of the {{source}} file were accounted for.
check.missing: Does not match: the file had {{rows}} rows and Aphel accounted for {{accounted}} (difference of {{count}}).
check.withProblems: All {{rows}} rows were accounted for, but {{count}} were not imported. Open the report to see why.

reconciliation.title: Check against {{source}}
reconciliation.description: Compare these file numbers with what {{source}} shows. Type the {{source}} number to see if it matches; if it does not, adjust before importing.
reconciliation.duplicates_one: {{count}} row repeats the identifier of another row in the file
reconciliation.duplicates_other: {{count}} rows repeat the identifier of another row in the file
